description: Verify one pool-level field of a deal: the ABS-EE loan-tape rollup against the 10-D trustee's reported fact. These are COLLATERAL (loan-pool) balances and flows, NOT bond or certificate balances, and SCHEDULED and ACTUAL are different fields. No loan_id. Always the CURRENT period. Pass claimed_value; no claim: UNVERIFIED; an unknown deal or field: OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

claimed_value.description: Claim to receipt. Required: no claim = refusal, no value.

field.description:
The deal-grain (pool) field to verify. One of (full definitions: coverage, or the receipt's field_definition):
• beginning_scheduled_collateral_balance — pool SCHEDULED collateral balance at period start (not bond balance)
• ending_scheduled_collateral_balance — pool SCHEDULED collateral balance at period end (not bond balance)
• ending_actual_collateral_balance — pool ACTUAL (as-paid) collateral balance at period end
• total_principal_collected — pool principal collected: scheduled plus unscheduled

name: verify_deal_field

resolved_deal.description: Deal resolution: matched, id, cik, candidates.

title: Verify a deal-grain (pool) field
